The main takeaway from our work is that

we were able to demonstrate that a topical tenofovir-based gel can provide a dose of tenofovor that can suppress HIV in the rectal tissue, which is the target for HIV transmission during anal intercourse.
the single dose of TDF was not sufficient to suppress HIV in the ex-vivo rectal tissue model.
